wants.topic: Origin stories of major deities (Trimurti, Vishnu, Shiva, Ganesha)
wants.evidence: Kalyug Rahasya videos "🔱 तीनों देवताओं की उत्पत्ति..." (vsNormal 96.35) and "🔱 भगवान विष्णु कौन हैं?" (vsNormal 55.72); The Divine Journey "भगवान विष्णु पत्थर क्यों बने?" (comment requests for more detail)

wants.topic: Historical recreations of festivals (e.g., "100 साल पहले Chhath Puja", "1926 में Diwali")
wants.evidence: The Divine Journey best videos on Chhath and Diwali with vsNormal 68.81 and 47.72; high engagement (comments 1362)
Kalyug Rahasya titles using "असली माता-पिता", "असली कथा" (vsNormal 78.31, 55.72); viewers often ask “क्या यह सच है?” in comments

wants.topic: Heroic rescue or moral‑lesson episodes (e.g., Shiva saving passengers)
wants.evidence: Hubba Bubba "Shiva Ne Apne Dimaag Se..." (vsNormal 30.12) attracted high per‑day views despite non‑mythology channel

wants.topic: Short, punchy “Katha” formats on lesser‑known myths (e.g., Mahishasura, Siddhidatri)
wants.evidence: Weakest videos on Mahishasura and Siddhidatri have very low vsNormal (<0.1), indicating demand for better‑produced, deeper versions

wants.topic: Requests for sequels/part 2 of popular stories
wants.evidence: Comments on high‑performing videos repeatedly ask “अगला भाग कब आएगा?” and “क्या आप इस कथा का दूसरा भाग बनाएँगे?”

gaps: In‑depth coverage of Pitru Paksha and ancestor‑worship stories (currently lowest vsNormal)
Comprehensive explanations of why certain deities turned into stone or took unusual forms (e.g., Vishnu stone myth)
Detailed narratives of lesser‑known festivals like Navratri day 9 (Siddhidatri) and regional customs
Analytical breakdown of symbolic meanings behind mythic events (e.g., Mahishasura’s defeat)
Modern‑life application of ancient myths (practical lessons missing in most videos)
saturated: General Trimurti origin tales – many channels repeat the same “parents of gods” angle
Standard Diwali/Chhath historical retrospectives – dozens of similar “100 साल पहले” videos
Generic “Katha” titles without a unique hook (e.g., simple “Diwali Ki Katha”)

"[Number] साल पहले" + festival name + "कैसी होती थी"
